headline: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Reports €100 Million Cyberattack Theft
summary: French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa disclosed that approximately €100 million was stolen from its accounts in a cyberattack. The bank assured that customers' funds remain safe.
why: Cyberattacks on financial institutions highlight operational risks and cybersecurity vulnerabilities within the banking sector.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: A French banking group suffered a major cyberattack theft.
